scope.calculations: Closed-form arithmetic from public source constants only. Published compact summaries and historical receipt read.

conclusion.established: The retained quantities are local Gaussian precision diagnostics. They do not carry a demonstrated posterior or confidence-coverage interpretation. Source arithmetic and saved probes do not establish a unique historical cause of SOC/Q undercoverage.
conclusion.boundary_only_remedy: No-go as a general repair. It addresses a real support inconsistency but cannot recover discarded historical nonlinear evidence, and the witness occurs later than the weight switch.
conclusion.defensible_next_action: One bounded, truth-free full-history likelihood control at an already archived prefix can test whether the saved recursive targets are compatible with a reoptimized historical model before choosing an embedded representation repair.

facts: Conditional SOC is mean plus/minus two row-factor SDs; capacity is exp(mean_logQ plus/minus two SD_logQ).
Aggregate uses within-plus-between marginal variance; its ranges are moment-Gaussian diagnostics, not mixture quantiles. Capacity point is exp(weighted logQ), not physical posterior mean.
Both components contribute to an unweighted local-range hull regardless of underflowed display weights. No covariance-diagonal-only query defect or missing between-component term was found.
findings.implication: Correct mixture quantiles would be required for literal mixture credible intervals, but cannot repair common conditional bias; the saved audit finds both conditional ranges wrong.

facts: Public means are hand-declared; diagonal variance is width squared divided by12. SOC uses entering width0.75 and RC entering voltages width0.16; all runtime means are checked only against the wider current-state box.
Exactly two logQ components preserve first two mixture moments but change prior density/higher moments; they overlap and are not disjoint physical capacity hypotheses.
Gaussian locations/covariances are not physical moments of a box-truncated Gaussian. Reusing them as truncation-kernel parameters changes physical moments.
findings.implication: Any support-consistent replacement must explicitly define its initial probability law or feasible-set semantics, including how inherited means/variances relate to that law. Public initialization is not truth-tuned.

equations: P_minus = F(mean) P F(mean)^T; static coordinate rows0..10 are copied unchanged.
g=P_minus H^T/sqrt(S), S=H P_minus H^T+sigma_V^2; t_i=lambda_i*g_i with0<=lambda_i<=1.
implications: Static marginal variances cannot increase in ordinary ingestion in real arithmetic; this is not a floating-point monotonicity guarantee.
No process covariance, forgetting, retained raw history or reevaluation of old nonlinear likelihood is present. No process noise is intrinsically required for the matched static-parameter model.
Changing a local Jacobian after prior compression can retain spurious certainty; the source establishes susceptibility, not when or why the archived trajectory became biased.

findings.assumptions: X~N(m,P), y=H X+epsilon, epsilon~N(0,R) independent; no truncation. Let nu=y-Hm, S=HPH^T+R, g=PH^T/sqrt(S), and selected normalized gain t=t(y).
equations: Exact conditional mean m_G=m+g*nu/sqrt(S), covariance P_G=P-g*g^T.
interpretation: J_t is the unconditional MSE identity for a gain fixed independently of y. With t(y), its expectation generally misses correlation with nu^2/S.
J_t is not the exact conditional covariance P_G, nor generally conditional MSE about m_t. With physical support the correct posterior differs further.
This is an assumed-covariance semantic issue, not proof of the historical cause and not a prescription to multiply covariance by the realized normalized residual.

findings.assumption: Initial H and h are independent under the declared diagonal Gaussian approximation. The product identity also holds for any independent supported marginals with these first two moments.
equations: The observation Jacobian retains only mu_H^2*Var(h) at this initial center.
caveats: This isolates one variance contribution at the public initial observation map; it is not the total predictive variance or an archived first-update measurement.

The existing32 axis nodes form a degree-three rule and can miss the independent H*h fourth-moment variance contribution. A finite discriminating fixture needs analytic product moments or mixed-coordinate integration.
The late tiny-covariance probe does not rule out this broad-belief historical approximation issue.

equations: For q=logQ~N(mu,v), E[1/Q]=exp(-mu+v/2), whereas predict uses exp(-mu).
For jointly Gaussian z,q and c=I*dt/3600: E[z_next]=mu_z-c*exp(-mu_q+v_q/2).
findings.caveat: Exact for the stated untruncated Gaussian chart distribution; not an archived bias attribution or an exact physically truncated prior calculation.

findings.identity: For static x and repeated y_i=f(x)+noise, full negative log likelihood is a constant plus N*(f(x)-mean(y))^2/(2sigma^2). At a fitted level set f(x)=mean(y), local Hessian has rank at most1. Summing Jacobian outer products at changing earlier estimates can spuriously resolve more directions.
findings.actual_model_link: At rest with known zero RC states, voltage U(z)-H*h is one scalar function of uncertain static z,H,h. A fabricated fixture can expose artificial information along its curved level set without truth or a long run.
findings.caveat: The real varying-current stream contains more information than this fixture. No conclusion that its true SOC/Q are unidentifiable follows.

equations: With Gaussian reference(m_G,P_G), scalar bounded h moments(m_T,v_T), and b=P_G[:,h]/P_G[h,h], joint mean=m_G+b*(m_T-m_G[h]), covariance=P_G+b*b^T*(v_T-P_G[h,h]).
comparison: Truncation to an interval has v_T<=P_G[h,h], hence contracts relative to that untruncated Gaussian kernel.

This does NOT imply physical covariance contracts between two already-supported prior/posterior distributions. A likelihood can move mass away from a bound and broaden physical variance while kernel covariance contracts.

Re-Gaussianizing supported moments and truncating again can shrink uncertainty with zero new information. Exact repeated support conditioning must be idempotent; keep support normalization/evidence ownership explicit.
findings.implication: A correct boundary representation is needed, but no general undercoverage repair or historical information recovery follows.

differences: Full reference minimizes voltage NLL with hard entering support z0 in[.2,.95], v_i0 in[-.08,.08], h0 in[-1,1]. It does not add the online Gaussian/mixture prior density.

Online uses those entering widths as initial moment scales but checks live means against wider current-state bounds. Therefore supports share provenance, but actual prior enforcement and density are not identical.

Full reference recomputes z from entering z0 and accumulated charge; online carries incrementally corrected current state. Exact model formulas agree, floating arithmetic and historical-state consistency are not identical.
Reference local assessment uses different precision-status thresholds; compare raw points, ranges, Gram, eigen/null diagnostics and costs, not status labels.

minimum_contract: One new diagnostic fit on all chosen archived observations, --method full --modes3 --sigma.001 --starts3 --max-iter120, public built-in starts only; no saved recursive Gaussian added to the objective. Record all statuses and finite failures; no adaptive starts or retries.

At most two predeclared constrained target fits, one fixed logQ at the recursive aggregate Q and one fixed-current-SOC at the same saved aggregate z; nuisance variables reoptimized. Baseline fit theta may be one declared start, not an independent prior. Report actual best objective and NLL differences without treating local high cost as global exclusion.
The unconstrained fit supplies current SOC=z0-charge/Q and Q plus undamped all-data joint Gram diagnostics. Compare both recursive components and aggregate at the exact same index/units.
If the baseline fails to converge or a constrained call finds a lower objective, preserve the solver limitation and classify inference as incomplete; do not open an adaptive campaign.

Pin source/binary/input/plan hashes, source chronology, exact child and supervisor RSS/CPU/wall, combined output cap and immutable originals. Any scoring remains separate and later. No inference tuning from truth.
full_history_control.comparison_warning: Do not compare recursive prequential scores directly to batch residual NLL. Do not use the latest corrected16-vector as if it were an initial state; its old RC/h state generally cannot be inverted after strong attenuation. Target-constrained history fits provide an interpretable alternative.

not_proved: A global optimum or global target exclusion.
Posterior credible coverage or frequentist confidence calibration.
The unique historical cause of the recursive undercoverage.

repair_scope: Choose explicit uncertainty semantics and an evidence representation capable of preserving the required nonlinear alternatives; a label change is not a performance repair.
Support-consistent conditioning must preserve joint dependencies, normalize predictive evidence correctly, and never count already-known support or replayed observations twice.
A supported Gaussian kernel, finite mixture or retained/relinearizable likelihood must pass broad-prior and curved-ridge checks, not only late small-covariance local checks.

If useful historical information has already been compressed away, no local mathematical projection can reconstruct it from the current mean/factor. A new candidate needs a history/evidence ownership and bounded-resource contract.

Nominal interval calibration ultimately requires an independent, predeclared validation population/replication design; a single selected prefix or profile is insufficient. No truth-tuned multiplier, arbitrary process noise, covariance floor or forced zero boundary variance is recommended.
